ValidationRule.description: the start and end date must be in the same calendar week
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: CEILING((( Start_Date__c - DATE(YEAR(Start_Date__c), 1, 1) + 1) + MOD(DATE(YEAR(Start_Date__c), 1, 1) - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7)) / 7) <> CEILING((( End_Date__c - DATE(YEAR(End_Date__c), 1, 1) + 1) + MOD(DATE(YEAR(End_Date__c), 1, 1) - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7)) / 7)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start and End Date must be in the same calendar week.
